responsibility: Implements the tree-SSA string length and formatted-output optimization/warning pass. It performs a dominator walk with per-pointer string-state tracking to infer lengths, nonzero prefixes, terminators, and allocation origins for string-like objects, uses that information to optimize strlen/memcpy/strcpy/printf-family calls and return values, and emits format-overflow, truncation, restrict, and related diagnostics based on the same analysis, with separate warning-only and optimizing pass entry points.
same_name_distinction: This .c file contains the executable strlen/printf analysis passes themselves, including the dominator walk, per-pointer string-state tracking, optimization transforms, diagnostics, and pass registration. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-strlen.h, it is not just the small exported helper interface for range queries, truncation helpers, and printf-call support.
